objects.name: The Fern-Choked Post
objects.vInscr: Ferns climb the post toward the flame, and shrink back from it, every night.

landmarks.name: The Unfaced Saint
landmarks.inscription: Its own order took the face away, lest the pilgrims learn to whom they had been praying.

landmarks.name: The Door Above the Wood
landmarks.inscription: The chapel was taken up whole, they say, and only the way in was left behind. Knock, and something on the far side knocks back.

landmarks.name: The Hill of Spent Prayers
landmarks.inscription: A thousand asked, and the little god drank every flame. Some still burn. Someone has not yet stopped asking.

landmarks.name: The Bound Oathwright
landmarks.inscription: They tied their god to the tree so it could not leave them. It did not leave. It did not answer either.
